magnolia-tx.lead: For Magnolia homes with long views across open land, custom drapery frames the back windows and adds soft texture to rooms that look out at the trees.
magnolia-tx.p1: Big Magnolia lots usually put the best view at the back of the house, the same side that takes the afternoon sun. We hang drapery rods high and extend them wide so the panels stack beside the glass when open, leaving the whole view clear. When the sun gets low, a solar shade underneath cuts the glare and the drapery stays put as the finish.
magnolia-tx.p2: Rooms that face the trees benefit most from texture. A textured fabric panel softens a wall of glass, and a sheer layered with it keeps the daytime light. At your free in-home consultation we bring fabric samples and measure every opening on site.
faqs: Can drapery in my Magnolia great room keep the view open?
Yes, we extend the rod past the window frame so the panels stack on the wall when they are open, and the glass stays clear from edge to edge.
What goes under drapery on a sunny Magnolia back window?
Usually a solar shade. It cuts glare and UV while you still see out, and the drapery hangs in front as the finished layer. We price both together in one written quote.

tomball-tx.lead: Tomball has older houses near the center of town and newer subdivisions around it, and custom drapery gets planned around whichever walls and windows your house actually has.
tomball-tx.p1: Older Tomball rooms can have walls and window frames that are slightly out of square, which shows quickly on a long rod. Our installers set every rod and bracket level and anchor it into what the wall can hold, then cut panel lengths so the hem lands evenly across the floor. The team that measures your room is the same team that hangs it.
tomball-tx.p2: In a newer Tomball subdivision home the question is usually scale: how high to mount and how far past the frame to extend. Mounting closer to the ceiling adds height to a standard room. Keep the drapery to living rooms and bedrooms, and leave the window over the kitchen sink to a blind or shutter.
faqs: Can you hang drapery level in an older Tomball house with uneven walls?
Yes, we level each rod or track at installation and anchor it to suit your wall. If anything we built does not match the approved measurements, it is remade at no cost.
Should drapery go in every room of my Tomball home?
Rarely. Most homes put drapery in the living room, dining room and primary bedroom, and use blinds, shades or shutters on the working windows. We plan it room by room at the consultation.

the-woodlands-tx.lead: Great rooms in The Woodlands often have glass that climbs well above reach, and custom drapery on a ceiling track or motorized track makes those walls look finished and easy to run.
the-woodlands-tx.p1: Tall windows need drapery hardware that can carry the weight over a long span. We install ceiling tracks and heavy rods with anchors chosen for your wall, so long panels hang straight. On glass nobody can reach, a motorized drapery track opens and closes the panels from a remote, an app, a voice assistant or a schedule.
the-woodlands-tx.p2: Homes set among the trees often get soft, shifting light, and a sheer layered with a heavier panel handles both the bright hours and the evening. Because drapery lives inside the house, the planning starts with the room itself: fabric, fullness and how far the panels stack beside the glass.
faqs: Can drapery in The Woodlands be motorized for a two-story window?
Yes, a motorized track moves the panels from a remote, app, voice assistant or schedule. It is quieter and smoother than most people expect, and the same team that measures installs it.
How do you hang long drapery panels in a tall great room in The Woodlands?
On a ceiling track or a heavy rod anchored for your wall. We measure on site, from a ladder where it takes one, and size panel lengths and stack widths to those numbers.

spring-tx.lead: Spring subdivision homes often have side windows facing the house next door, and custom drapery layered over a privacy shade gives those rooms a finished look with light still coming in.
spring-tx.p1: The shade does the privacy work on a Spring side window, lowering from the top or rising from the bottom to keep the neighbor out of view. Drapery hangs in front of it and adds the softness a plain shade lacks. We plan and price both layers together, so the rod clears the shade and the panels stack off the glass.
spring-tx.p2: Bedrooms in Spring tend to need more darkness than a shade gives on its own. A blackout panel layered with a sheer handles night and day at the same window. Front rooms that face the street get the same pairing in a lighter fabric.
faqs: Can I put drapery over a top-down shade in my Spring home?
Yes, we mount the drapery hardware high and wide enough to clear the shade, so both layers work on their own. The shade handles privacy, and the drapery finishes the window.
What drapery works for a Spring bedroom that faces the street?
A blackout panel layered with a sheer is the usual choice. The sheer softens daylight, and the blackout panel closes the room at night. We bring fabric samples to your free consultation.

conroe-tx.lead: A new Conroe house usually arrives with bare windows or builder blinds, and custom drapery is the layer that makes the living room and dining room feel lived in.
conroe-tx.p1: When we plan a whole Conroe house in one visit, drapery usually goes on the windows people see first: the living room, the dining room and the primary bedroom. The builder blinds can stay behind it for now or be replaced with a shade later. We measure every opening on site and write one quote with installation included.
conroe-tx.p2: We can talk through timing for a new build at the consultation, because rod height depends on where the ceiling and trim end up. Mounting near the ceiling and extending past the frame makes standard builder windows look taller and wider.
faqs: Can drapery go over the builder blinds in my new Conroe home?
Yes, we mount the rod outside and above the frame so the panels clear the blind. Some homeowners start with drapery in the main rooms and replace the blinds later.
Which Conroe rooms should get drapery first?
The rooms you see and use most, usually the living room and primary bedroom. We plan the whole house in one visit and put it all on one written quote, which makes it easy to phase.

montgomery-tx.lead: On Lake Conroe, Montgomery homes face water that throws glare into the room, and custom drapery frames the lake view while a solar shade behind it takes the glare.
montgomery-tx.p1: Glare off the water arrives at a low angle and fills the room. A solar shade cuts it and keeps the lake visible, and drapery hung outside the frame gives that window a finished edge. We extend the rod wide enough that the panels stack on the wall, leaving the full width of glass for the view when they are open.
montgomery-tx.p2: A Montgomery bedroom that faces the lake gets bright early. Pair a sheer with a blackout panel and close only the layer you need. In a sunroom on the water, a motorized track can draw the panels across a wall of glass with one command.
faqs: Will drapery block my lake view in Montgomery?
Only when you close it. The rod extends past the frame so open panels stack beside the glass, and a solar shade underneath cuts glare while you still see the water.
Can drapery in a Montgomery sunroom be motorized?
Yes, a motorized drapery track can open and close panels across wide glass from a remote, app, voice assistant or a schedule you set.

willis-tx.lead: In a Willis summer the sunniest glass needs a working shade first, and custom drapery layered in front finishes the bedrooms and living room you spend the most time in.
willis-tx.p1: On the windows that take the most sun, a cellular shade does the heat work, its cells slowing heat through the glass. Drapery adds the second layer: a blackout panel for bedrooms, a lighter fabric for the living room. We size the rod so both layers move freely and quote them together with installation included.
willis-tx.p2: Working on a budget, start with shades on the hottest windows and add drapery to the bedrooms next. Every opening is measured on site at the first visit, so the drapery added later is built to the same numbers.
faqs: Is drapery or a cellular shade better for a hot Willis bedroom?
They do different jobs. The cellular shade insulates the glass, and a blackout drapery panel darkens and finishes the room. Many bedrooms get both, priced together.
Can I add drapery later to the shades you install in my Willis home?
Yes, we measure every opening at the first visit, so drapery hardware can be planned to clear the shades whenever you add it.

pinehurst-tx.lead: On wooded Pinehurst lots the trees already soften the sun, so custom drapery can be chosen for texture and finish while a light filtering shade handles daytime privacy.
pinehurst-tx.p1: Most rooms on a shaded Pinehurst lot need privacy more than sun control. A light filtering shade gives that during the day and keeps the daylight, and drapery hung in front adds the texture a wooded setting calls for. We plan fullness generously, because panels with plenty of fabric look finished open or closed.
pinehurst-tx.p2: Bedrooms often pair drapery with a roman shade underneath, so the shade handles the daily light and the drapery adds softness at the sides. Natural textures suit a wooded setting, and we bring fabric samples to your free in-home consultation.
faqs: What drapery fabric suits a shaded Pinehurst living room?
Textured fabric with some weight, hung over a light filtering shade. The shade keeps daylight and privacy, and the drapery adds warmth and softness at the sides.
Can drapery hang over a roman shade in a Pinehurst bedroom?
Yes, we mount the drapery rod above and outside the shade so each layer works on its own, and we quote both with installation included.

stagecoach-tx.lead: Stagecoach homes with an outdoor kitchen or dining area usually have a wide door or wall of glass facing it, and custom drapery dresses that opening from the inside.
stagecoach-tx.p1: The glass between a Stagecoach living room and the outdoor room is often a slider or a wide set of doors. Drapery on a rod or track draws across it and stacks beside the frame when open, so the path outside stays clear. Exterior shades handle the sun on the patio itself, and we plan both in the same visit.
stagecoach-tx.p2: If the outdoor shades are motorized, the drapery can be too. A motorized track opens and closes the panels from a remote, app, voice assistant or schedule, which keeps the inside and outside of that wall on the same routine.
faqs: Can drapery go over the slider to my Stagecoach patio?
Yes, panels on a rod or track draw across the door and stack beside it when open. We size the stack width so the door slides and the walkway stays clear.
Can you plan patio shades and indoor drapery for my Stagecoach home together?
Yes, we measure for both at the same free consultation and put them on one written quote, and the same team that measures does the installation.

hockley-tx.lead: Hockley houses with nothing between the west windows and the horizon need sun control at the glass, and custom drapery layered over it gives those rooms their finished look.
hockley-tx.p1: Low western sun on an open Hockley lot is a job for an exterior shade or a solar shade, which stop or cut the heat and glare before it fills the room. Drapery belongs in front of that shade, hung high and wide so it adds height and softness and leaves the glass uncovered when open. We plan the layers together in one written quote.
hockley-tx.p2: For west-facing living rooms, choose drapery fabric for the evening: a heavier panel closes the room after sunset, and a sheer keeps it soft in the afternoon. Every rod and track is anchored for your wall, which matters on long spans.
faqs: Does drapery stop the afternoon heat on my Hockley west windows?
The heat work is better done by an exterior or solar shade, which stops or cuts the sun at the glass. Drapery layers over it to finish the room, and we quote both together.
How wide should drapery hang on a large Hockley window?
Wide enough that open panels stack on the wall beside the glass. We measure on site and set the rod length and panel stack width to your window and wall.

waller-tx.lead: Waller homes often save their hardest openings for the back of the house, French doors and sliders, and custom drapery can dress them when it hangs wide enough to clear.
waller-tx.p1: For French doors, the drapery rod has to extend far enough that the open panels stack completely clear of the doors, so they swing without catching. On a Waller slider, panels on a rod or track draw across the glass and stack beside it, moving the same direction the door does. We measure the clearance at the handle and walkway on site.
waller-tx.p2: Wide windows along the back of a Waller house suit a long rod or ceiling track with generous fullness. Heavy spans need the right anchors, and our installers choose them for your wall. Ask about a motorized track if the panels cross a lot of glass.
faqs: Will drapery get in the way of my French doors in Waller?
Not when it is hung wide enough. We extend the rod so the panels stack fully clear of the doors when open, and the doors swing freely.
Is drapery or a panel track better for a Waller sliding door?
Panel tracks suit a door used many times a day. Drapery adds softness to a room with a lot of hard glass. We bring both to the consultation and help you pick.

prairie-view-tx.lead: Prairie View homes and rental properties need window treatments that wear well, and custom drapery earns its place in the rooms where softness and finish matter most.
prairie-view-tx.p1: Drapery holds up when the hardware is right. Our installers anchor every rod and track for the wall it goes into, and panels hung level with enough fullness keep their shape through daily opening and closing. Each piece is measured on site and built to those numbers, backed by the manufacturer's limited lifetime warranty and our four-year service guarantee.
prairie-view-tx.p2: In a Prairie View rental, keep drapery to the living room or primary bedroom and use durable blinds on the busy windows. A motorized track means nobody tugs on the fabric to open it, which helps panels that get moved every day.
faqs: Is drapery a good choice for a Prairie View rental property?
In the main living area it can be, when the rod is anchored properly and the panels are sized right. For high-use windows, faux wood blinds or shutters usually wear better.
What warranty comes with drapery installed in Prairie View?
Products carry the manufacturer's limited lifetime warranty, and our work carries a four-year service guarantee. Anything that does not match the approved measurements is remade at no cost.

shenandoah-tx.lead: Shenandoah homeowners usually start with the bedroom, and custom drapery hung wide over a blackout shade covers the sides of the window where a shade alone leaves a gap.
shenandoah-tx.p1: A shade inside the frame leaves a thin line of light down each side. Drapery mounted outside and past the frame closes over that gap when drawn, and a blackout panel adds its own layer of darkness. In a Shenandoah bedroom we plan the shade and drapery together so the rod sits high enough and wide enough to cover both edges.
shenandoah-tx.p2: Pair the blackout panel with a sheer for daytime, or keep it simple with one heavy layer. A cellular blackout shade underneath adds insulation as well as darkness. Every measurement is taken in your room, and anything that misses the approved numbers is remade at no cost.
faqs: Will drapery make my Shenandoah bedroom darker than a shade alone?
Drapery mounted wide over the shade covers the light that slips down the sides, and a blackout panel adds a second layer. Together they darken the room more than either one alone.
What shade should go under bedroom drapery in Shenandoah?
A blackout cellular shade is a common pick because it insulates the glass too. We bring samples of both layers to your free in-home consultation and quote them together.

oak-ridge-north-tx.lead: Oak Ridge North homes are established, and so is a lot of their drapery, so the first question at our consultation is often what to replace and what to keep.
oak-ridge-north-tx.p1: Older drapery tends to show its age in the hardware first: a rod that sags in the middle, brackets pulling from the wall, panels that no longer reach the floor evenly. When we replace it in an Oak Ridge North home, we set new rods level, anchor them for the wall, and cut lengths to the floor you have now.
oak-ridge-north-tx.p2: For front rooms, drapery works well layered with real wood blinds or shutters, which handle light while the panels add softness and height. Mounting the new rod higher than the old one often makes the room look taller.
faqs: How do I know it is time to replace drapery in my Oak Ridge North home?
Sagging rods, loose brackets, faded or skimpy panels, and hems that no longer sit evenly are the usual signs. We look at each window during the free consultation.
Can new drapery hang over the shutters in my Oak Ridge North front room?
Yes, we mount the rod above and outside the shutter frame so the panels clear the louvers, and we quote fabric, hardware and installation together.

dallas-tx.lead: Dallas homes run from new builds with walls of glass to older houses with original windows, and custom drapery is the layer that finishes the room in both.
dallas-tx.p1: On a Dallas wall of glass, drapery on a ceiling track or long rod frames the whole span, and a motorized track can glide the panels open with one command. In an older house the work is different: rods set level against original trim, and panel lengths measured to the actual floor. Our team measures each window and installs what it measured.
dallas-tx.p2: Choose fabric by the room's job. A sheer layered with a blackout panel suits bedrooms, and a heavier textured panel over a shade suits a living room. Generous fullness is what makes drapery read as custom when it is closed.
faqs: Can you motorize drapery across a wall of glass in my Dallas home?
Yes, a motorized track glides the panels from a remote, app, voice assistant or schedule, and it is quieter than most people expect. We plan the track and fabric together.
Do you install drapery in older Dallas homes with original windows?
Yes, we measure each opening and wall on site, level every rod or track, and cut lengths to your floor. If it does not match the approved measurements, it is remade at no cost.

fort-worth-tx.lead: Fort Worth afternoons push sun into the back of the house for hours, and custom drapery over a working shade dresses the large windows that face the yard.
fort-worth-tx.p1: The heat work on those back windows belongs to a patio shade outside or a solar shade inside. Drapery is the finishing layer, hung near the ceiling and past the frame so it makes a large Fort Worth window look even bigger and leaves the glass clear when open. We plan the shade and drapery together, with one written quote.
fort-worth-tx.p2: Front rooms often carry shutters, and drapery can frame them for a more formal look. For the yard side, choose a fabric with enough weight to hang straight on a long span, and consider a motorized track if the window is wide.
faqs: Should my Fort Worth back windows get drapery or patio shades?
Often both. Patio shades stop the sun outside the glass, and drapery inside finishes the room. We measure for both on the same free visit.
Can drapery frame plantation shutters in a Fort Worth front room?
Yes, the rod goes above and outside the shutter frame so the louvers still tilt freely, and the panels stack on the wall beside the window.

austin-tx.lead: Many Austin homes are built around a view of the hills, the water or the trees, and custom drapery frames that view while the shade behind it handles the sun.
austin-tx.p1: On an Austin view window, the drapery rod extends well past the frame so the open panels stack on the wall and nothing covers the glass. A see-through solar shade underneath cuts glare and UV while keeping the view, and the drapery closes over it at night. We measure the stack width on site so the view stays whole.
austin-tx.p2: Natural interiors suit natural textures. A textured fabric pairs well with a woven wood shade, and a sheer softens a west window in the late afternoon. Bring your fabric questions to the free in-home consultation, where we lay samples against your walls and floors.
faqs: How do I keep my Austin view with drapery on the window?
Hang the rod wide so the open panels stack beside the glass. A solar shade underneath cuts glare during the day, and the drapery closes over it in the evening.
Can drapery go over a woven wood shade in an Austin living room?
Yes, texture plus function is a common pairing. The woven wood shade handles daily light, and the drapery adds softness and height around it.

arlington-tx.lead: Busy Arlington family homes are hard on anything at the window, and custom drapery holds up best on a well-anchored rod or a motorized track nobody has to tug.
arlington-tx.p1: Panels get pulled, grabbed and leaned on in an Arlington family room. A rod anchored properly for the wall takes that daily handling, and a motorized track takes the pulling away altogether, opening the panels from a remote, app or schedule. We install the hardware ourselves, and the team that measured is the team that hangs it.
arlington-tx.p2: Keep drapery to the rooms where it adds the most, like the living room and the primary bedroom, and use faux wood where messes happen. On a slider used all day, drapery has to stack fully beside the door so nobody walks through fabric.
faqs: Is motorized drapery practical in a busy Arlington home?
It is a good fit. A motorized track opens and closes the panels from a remote, app, voice assistant or schedule, so the fabric gets handled far less.
Can drapery work on an Arlington sliding door that gets used all day?
It can if the rod extends far enough that open panels stack completely beside the door. For heavy daily traffic, a panel track is also worth comparing at the consultation.

plano-tx.lead: Plenty of Plano homes still have the blinds they came with, and adding custom drapery is a visible way to update a room while those blinds stay in place.
plano-tx.p1: In a Plano living room with original blinds, drapery mounted near the ceiling and extended past the frame changes how the whole wall looks. The blinds keep handling light and privacy, and the panels add softness, height and color. When the blinds are later replaced with shutters or a roman shade, the drapery hardware can often stay where it is.
plano-tx.p2: Entries and sidelights are usually better served by shutters or door-mounted shades, so drapery is planned for the main rooms. We build every piece to your openings and quote fabric, hardware and installation together. The consultation is free and happens in your home.
faqs: Can I add drapery in my Plano home and keep the existing blinds?
Yes, we mount the drapery hardware outside the frame so it clears the blinds. Both layers work independently, and you can replace the blinds later.
What drapery length looks best in a Plano living room?
Most rooms look best with panels that just kiss the floor or float slightly above it. We measure the drop on site and hem each panel to that number.

irving-tx.lead: Irving bedrooms that need to stay dark for sleep, and home offices that need a cleaner backdrop for calls, both suit custom drapery layered over a working shade.
irving-tx.p1: In an Irving bedroom, a blackout drapery panel layered with a sheer gives you a dark room at night and soft light by day. Mounted outside and past the frame, it closes over the shade beneath it. We plan the shade and the drapery in one visit and price both with installation included.
irving-tx.p2: For a home office, drapery behind the desk gives video calls a softer background than bare glass or a plain blind. A motorized track can open the panels in the morning and close them on a schedule when the workday ends.
faqs: What drapery helps an Irving bedroom stay dark?
A blackout panel, usually layered with a sheer and hung over a shade. The drapery covers the edges of the window, and the shade adds a second layer of light control.
Can you install drapery in an Irving home office?
Yes, a sheer panel for daytime light and a heavier panel for calls is a common pairing. We measure the window on site and hang both on hardware sized for the wall.

frisco-tx.lead: New Frisco homes are big, bright and tall, and custom drapery on ceiling tracks and long rods gives two-story windows and media rooms a finished look at the right scale.
frisco-tx.p1: A two-story Frisco window needs drapery hardware that carries long, heavy panels without sagging. We install ceiling tracks and heavy rods with the right anchors for the wall, and size panel lengths so the hem sits precisely at the floor. When the top of the window is out of reach, a motorized track runs the panels from a remote or a schedule.
frisco-tx.p2: Media and game rooms want darkness on demand. A blackout drapery panel over a shade covers the glass when drawn. In a great room with transoms, mounting above the transom carries the drapery up the full height of the wall.
faqs: Can you hang drapery on a two-story window in my Frisco home?
Yes, we use ceiling tracks or heavy rods anchored for your wall, measure from ladders where needed, and can add a motorized track for panels nobody can reach.
What drapery works in a Frisco media room?
A blackout panel layered over a shade. The shade handles daytime light, and the drapery darkens the room for movies. A motorized track lets you close it from the couch.

mckinney-tx.lead: McKinney homes with arched tops and bay windows need drapery planned to the shape of the opening, and every custom panel and rod we install is measured on site.
mckinney-tx.p1: On an arched McKinney window, mounting the drapery above the arch and extending it wide keeps the curve visible when the panels are open. In a bay, the layout depends on the walls between the windows, and we work it out at the consultation with the opening in front of us. Our measurements set every panel length and stack width.
mckinney-tx.p2: Older homes near downtown McKinney often have character rooms where a roman shade and drapery together look right. The shade handles light, and the drapery frames the window with softness and height. Bedrooms with a row of windows suit one long rod across the whole run.
faqs: Can drapery go on an arched window in my McKinney home?
Yes, we mount the hardware above the arch and extend it past the frame, so open panels stack on the wall and the shape of the window stays visible.
How do you hang drapery across a row of bedroom windows in McKinney?
Usually on one long rod or a ceiling track across the whole run, anchored for the span. The panels then close as one wall of fabric.

grand-prairie-tx.lead: Grand Prairie living rooms need different light at breakfast and after dark, and custom drapery adds a second layer to the shade so the room handles both.
grand-prairie-tx.p1: Dual and banded shades change the light from one headrail. Drapery takes the same idea to the whole window: a sheer for bright mornings, a heavier panel for evenings, both hung outside the frame around the shade. In a Grand Prairie front room, that pairing gives you choices across the whole day.
grand-prairie-tx.p2: Bedrooms that need the darker layer can take a blackout drapery panel over a shade. We bring fabric samples to your home, measure every window, and give you a written quote with installation included. The same team then installs what it measured.
faqs: Can drapery hang over a banded shade in my Grand Prairie home?
Yes, the rod goes above and wide of the shade, so both work independently. The banded shade adjusts privacy, and the drapery finishes the window.
Which drapery fabric is best for a Grand Prairie bedroom?
A blackout panel, often paired with a sheer for daytime. We help you choose fabric at the free consultation, with samples in the room where they will hang.

denton-tx.lead: Denton homes work their glass hard in summer and winter, and custom drapery layered over a cellular shade finishes the rooms where that shade does the insulating.
denton-tx.p1: The insulating work in a Denton bedroom belongs to a double cell shade, which slows heat through the glass in both directions. Drapery goes in front of it as the finishing layer. A blackout panel adds darkness for sleep, and hanging it high and wide makes a modest bedroom window look larger. We quote both layers together.
denton-tx.p2: For front rooms with shutters, drapery panels at the sides add softness and leave the louvers clear. Living rooms suit textured fabrics with generous fullness. Every opening is measured on site, and the team that measures installs.
faqs: Should my Denton bedroom get drapery or a cellular shade?
The cellular shade does the insulating. Drapery adds a finished layer and darkness, and we plan the two together so they both fit and work at that window.
Can you put drapery beside plantation shutters in a Denton front room?
Yes, side panels on a rod mounted above the shutter frame keep the louvers free to tilt and add softness to the window.

waco-tx.lead: Waco rentals, guest houses and short-term stays go through a lot of guests, and custom drapery in those rooms has to hang straight, match across units and wear well.
waco-tx.p1: In a Waco short-term rental or guest house, drapery gives the main room and bedroom a finished look in listing photos and in person. We anchor rods and tracks for the wall so they stay level through constant use, and we cut every panel to measured lengths so units with the same windows look the same from one to the next.
waco-tx.p2: Guest rooms usually pair a blackout roller shade with a drapery panel for the look. Student rentals near the university tend to do better with blinds on most windows and drapery only in the living area.
faqs: Is drapery durable enough for a Waco short-term rental?
With the right hardware it is. We anchor rods for your wall and size panels with proper fullness, and the products carry a manufacturer's limited lifetime warranty.
Can you match drapery across several Waco rental units?
Yes, we measure each unit on site and build to those numbers, so the same fabric and hanging height can repeat from one unit to the next.

lewisville-tx.lead: French doors and sliders are the glass used most in many Lewisville homes, and custom drapery on them has to stack clear so every door still opens freely.
lewisville-tx.p1: For French doors to the patio, we extend the rod far enough that the panels stack completely off the doors when open, so they swing without brushing fabric. On the back slider, drapery on a rod or track draws across the glass and stacks to one side, the same direction the door moves. We measure handles, swing and walkway on site.
lewisville-tx.p2: Glass beside the front door is a job for a shutter or a door-mounted shade, so drapery planning in Lewisville homes starts at the back of the house. A motorized track on the slider can open and close the panels on a schedule.
faqs: How far should drapery extend beside French doors in my Lewisville home?
Far enough that the open panels stack completely clear of both doors. We measure the door swing and the panel stack width on site and size the rod to match.
Does drapery on a Lewisville sliding door need a track?
It can hang from a rod or a track. A track suits a long span or a motorized setup, and both stack the panels beside the door when it is open.

round-rock-tx.lead: Round Rock home offices rarely have the window where the screen needs it, and custom drapery over a solar shade gives that room a finished look while the shade cuts the glare.
round-rock-tx.p1: In a Round Rock office, the solar shade does the daytime work, cutting glare on the screen and keeping the room bright. Drapery hangs in front of it on a rod set high and wide, adding softness to a room that is often all desk and shelving. A sheer panel works for daylight, and a heavier one closes the office at night.
round-rock-tx.p2: An office at the front of the house may suit shutters with drapery at the sides. If the office is also a guest room, choose a blackout panel. We measure every window and give you a written quote that includes installation.
faqs: Will drapery help with screen glare in my Round Rock home office?
A solar shade handles the glare best. Drapery layered over it adds softness and closes the room off at the end of the day.
What drapery suits a Round Rock office that doubles as a guest room?
A blackout panel layered with a sheer. The sheer keeps the desk bright during work hours, and the blackout panel darkens the room for guests.

tyler-tx.lead: Traditional Tyler homes often keep a formal living room and dining room at the front, and custom drapery hung high and wide is what makes those rooms look finished.
tyler-tx.p1: Mounting the rod close to the ceiling adds height to a Tyler living room, and extending it past the frame lets the panels stack on the wall so the window looks wider. Generous fullness matters in formal rooms, where skimpy panels read as unfinished. We hem each panel to kiss the floor or float just above it, measured in your room.
tyler-tx.p2: In the dining room, drapery pairs well with a roman shade that handles daily light. On front windows with shutters, side panels add softness and keep the louvers free. Bring your fabric ideas to the free consultation and we will bring samples.
faqs: How high should drapery hang in a formal Tyler living room?
Usually close to the ceiling, which adds height to the room. We measure the wall and window on site and set the rod height and width to suit both.
Can drapery and a roman shade work together in my Tyler dining room?
Yes, the roman shade handles light, and the drapery frames the window. We plan both so the rod clears the shade and quote them together.

georgetown-tx.lead: Georgetown homeowners who want window treatments that are easy to run every day can have custom drapery on a motorized track that opens with one button.
georgetown-tx.p1: Pulling heavy panels across a wide window is the hardest part of living with drapery. A motorized track in a Georgetown living room takes that job over, gliding the panels from a remote, a wall switch, an app, a voice assistant or a schedule. It runs more quietly and smoothly than most people expect.
georgetown-tx.p2: Group the drapery with the room's motorized shades and one button runs the whole room. Keep fabric away from the tub and the kitchen sink, where a cordless shade or shutter is the better fit. We plan every room in one visit.
faqs: Can motorized drapery in my Georgetown home run on a schedule?
Yes, a motorized track can open the panels in the morning and close them in the evening on a schedule, or respond to a remote, app or voice assistant.
Do you install drapery in Georgetown active adult communities?
Yes, a motorized track is worth considering there, since the panels then open and close from a remote, wall switch or schedule. The same team that measures your windows installs them.

flower-mound-tx.lead: Flower Mound homes with a pool out back take sun on the rear windows from above and off the water, and custom drapery frames them while a solar shade handles glare.
flower-mound-tx.p1: Light bounces off a Flower Mound pool into the breakfast room and living room for much of the day. A solar shade cuts that glare and keeps the yard in view. Drapery hung outside the frame adds a finished edge, and when it is drawn open it stacks on the wall so the view of the pool stays clear.
flower-mound-tx.p2: On a wide door to the pool patio, drapery on a track draws across the glass and stacks beside the door. Exterior shades on the patio itself handle the sun outside, and we plan inside and outside at the same consultation.
faqs: Can drapery keep the pool view open in my Flower Mound breakfast room?
Yes, the rod extends past the frame so open panels stack beside the glass, and a solar shade underneath takes the glare while you still see the yard.
Should I put drapery on the door to my Flower Mound pool patio?
It works if the panels stack fully beside the door. A track handles a wide span, and a motorized one opens and closes on a schedule.

north-richland-hills-tx.lead: North Richland Hills kitchens and baths need hard-wearing treatments near water, and custom drapery belongs in the rooms beyond them, where fabric stays dry and soft.
north-richland-hills-tx.p1: We start North Richland Hills homes at the kitchen sink with a shutter or faux wood blind, then plan fabric where splashes cannot reach. Drapery in the breakfast nook, living room or primary bedroom adds the softness those wipe-clean surfaces lack. Rods are set level and anchored for the wall, and panel lengths are hemmed to kiss the floor or float.
north-richland-hills-tx.p2: A sheer on a breakfast-room window softens morning light near the kitchen and stays out of the way. In the primary bedroom, a blackout panel layered with a sheer gives you both day and night from one window.
faqs: Can I put drapery near the kitchen in my North Richland Hills home?
Keep it away from the sink and the stove. A breakfast area or adjoining living room is a good place for drapery, with a shutter or faux wood blind at the sink.
What drapery length works in a North Richland Hills primary bedroom?
Either a hem that kisses the floor or one that floats just above it. We measure the drop in your room and build each panel to that length.

euless-tx.lead: Euless living rooms that face the street often sit behind shut blinds all day, and custom drapery layered over a privacy shade lets those rooms take in daylight again.
euless-tx.p1: In a Euless front room, a top-down bottom-up or banded shade does the privacy work, covering the part of the window people can see into and leaving the rest open to light. Drapery frames that shade from outside the frame, adding the softness and height a plain shade lacks. We plan and quote both layers together with installation.
euless-tx.p2: Walls of glass and patio doors suit drapery on a ceiling track or a long rod, stacked beside the glass when open. For wide spans, a motorized track glides the panels with one command from a remote or app.
faqs: Can drapery and a banded shade work together in a Euless living room?
Yes, the banded shade adjusts privacy through the day, and the drapery hangs outside the frame as the finished layer. We plan clearance so each moves on its own.
What hardware do you use for drapery across Euless patio doors?
A long rod or a ceiling track, anchored for your wall. We size it so the open panels stack beside the doors and the walkway stays clear.

celina-tx.lead: East-facing Celina bedrooms catch the sun at first light, and custom drapery hung wide over a blackout shade keeps those rooms dark until you open them.
celina-tx.p1: A blackout cellular shade darkens the glass, but light can still show at the sides of the frame. Drapery mounted past the frame in a Celina bedroom closes over those edges, and a blackout panel adds its own layer. Layer a sheer with it and the same window gives you soft daylight once you are up.
celina-tx.p2: Bedrooms with windows on both sides of the bed look best when both get matching panels at the same rod height. For a softer look, a roman shade with a blackout liner can sit under the drapery instead of the cellular shade.
faqs: Can drapery stop early morning light in my Celina bedroom?
Paired with a blackout shade, it helps a lot. The drapery hangs wide enough to cover the edges of the window, and the blackout panel adds a second layer.
Should both windows beside the bed in my Celina home get drapery?
Yes, for balance. We set both rods at the same height and build matching panels, so the wall looks planned around the bed.

grapevine-tx.lead: Grapevine sunrooms and breakfast rooms with glass on three sides get sun from morning to evening, and custom drapery can be planned wall by wall to match it.
grapevine-tx.p1: Each wall in a Grapevine sunroom takes the sun at a different hour, so each one gets its own plan. Drapery at the ends of each wall frames the room, while shutters or solar shades on the glass do the daily light work. A motorized track can close a wall of drapery on a schedule as the sun moves around the house.
grapevine-tx.p2: For pool-facing living rooms, keep the drapery stack wide so the open panels sit on the wall and the water view stays whole. Ceiling tracks suit rooms where the glass runs nearly to the ceiling.
faqs: Can drapery in my Grapevine sunroom move on a schedule?
Yes, a motorized track can open and close each wall of panels at set times, or from a remote, app or voice assistant when you want to change it.
How do you hang drapery in a Grapevine room with glass on three sides?
Wall by wall, on rods or ceiling tracks sized to each run. We measure every opening on site and plan where the panels stack so the corners look clean.

sherman-tx.lead: Sherman summers run long and hot and winters bring cold snaps, so custom drapery here usually hangs over a cellular shade that insulates the glass in both seasons.
sherman-tx.p1: In the coldest rooms of a Sherman home, the plan is two layers: a cellular shade on the glass, whose cells slow heat moving in either direction, and drapery hung in front of it. The drapery gives the room softness and a finished look, and a heavier fabric closed at night puts one more layer over the window.
sherman-tx.p2: Front rooms with shutters can take drapery panels at the sides. Measure once for both layers: we take every number on site, quote shade and drapery together, and the team that measures is the team that installs.
faqs: What goes under drapery in a cold Sherman bedroom?
A cellular shade is the usual choice because its cells insulate the glass in summer and winter. The drapery hangs in front as the finishing layer.
Can you plan drapery and shades for my Sherman home on the same visit?
Yes, we measure for both at the free consultation and include both in one written quote with installation. The same team handles the install.

bedford-tx.lead: Strong sun slowly fades floors, rugs and art in Bedford homes, so custom drapery in those rooms is planned with a solar shade behind it to cut the UV.
bedford-tx.p1: A solar shade cuts glare and UV at the glass and keeps a Bedford living room bright. Drapery adds the layer that finishes the room, hung high to add height and wide so the stack clears the window. Fabric at a sunny window takes that sun too, so we help you choose drapery fabric with each window's exposure in mind.
bedford-tx.p2: Rooms with art on the walls benefit from controlled light. Drawing the drapery during the brightest hours, with the solar shade lowered, keeps direct sun off the walls. A motorized track can do that on a schedule.
faqs: Does drapery protect floors and art from fading in Bedford?
The solar shade does most of that work by cutting UV at the glass. Drapery drawn during the brightest hours adds coverage, and a motorized track can close it on a schedule.
Can drapery go over a roman shade in a Bedford living room?
Yes, we set the rod above and outside the shade so both layers move freely, and we bring fabric samples for both to the free consultation.

waxahachie-tx.lead: Older Waxahachie houses and farmhouses on acreage have wood trim, wood floors and sometimes stone, and custom drapery in a textured fabric suits those rooms.
waxahachie-tx.p1: Drapery in a Waxahachie farmhouse works best when it reads as part of the room's materials. A textured fabric beside a woven wood shade, or panels framing real wood blinds, ties the window to the floors and trim. Older walls can be uneven, so we level every rod and choose anchors for wood plank or stone.
waxahachie-tx.p2: Where the ceilings are high, mounting the rod near the top adds height to the room. In bedrooms, a roman shade under the drapery handles light while the panels soften the room. The quote is written and includes installation.
faqs: Can you hang drapery on stone or plank walls in a Waxahachie home?
Yes, our installers choose anchors for the wall the rod goes into and set every rod level. Heavy rods and long spans get the hardware they need.
What drapery suits a Waxahachie farmhouse?
Textured fabric with generous fullness, often layered over a woven wood shade or real wood blinds. We bring samples to your home so you see them against your own trim and floors.

keller-tx.lead: A shade on its own can leave a large Keller living room or primary bedroom looking unfinished, and custom drapery layered over it completes the room.
keller-tx.p1: The shade does the work of light, privacy and darkness, and the drapery finishes the window. In Keller homes we plan both together so the rod sits above and outside the shade, the panels clear it when open, and the shade still raises and lowers without catching fabric. One written quote covers both layers and the installation.
keller-tx.p2: Choose the drapery by room. A blackout panel over a cellular shade suits a primary bedroom, and a textured panel over a roman shade suits a dining room. In the rooms that work hardest, shutters with side panels give durability and softness together.
faqs: How do you plan drapery over existing shades in a Keller home?
We measure the shade and the wall around it, then set the rod height and width so the panels clear the shade. Both layers then work independently.
Is drapery over a shade worth it in a Keller primary bedroom?
For most large bedrooms it is what makes the room look complete. The shade handles light and privacy, and a blackout drapery panel adds darkness and softness.

haltom-city-tx.lead: Covering a whole Haltom City house at once is a big purchase, so custom drapery usually goes where it shows most, like the living room and primary bedroom.
haltom-city-tx.p1: Spending where the house is seen makes the budget go further. In a Haltom City home, drapery in the living room gives the main space a finished look, while simple, durable blinds handle the other windows. We plan the whole house room by room in one visit and write a quote you can phase.
haltom-city-tx.p2: For the primary bedroom, a blackout drapery panel over a basic shade gives you darkness and softness without a second premium treatment. Rods are anchored and leveled by the same team that measured, and the work carries our four-year service guarantee.
faqs: Where should drapery go first in my Haltom City home?
The living room and primary bedroom, where it shows and gets used the most. The rest of the house can start with faux wood blinds and add drapery later.
Can I phase drapery across my Haltom City home?
Yes, we measure every window at the first visit, so later rooms are built to the same numbers, and you choose which rooms to start with.

prosper-tx.lead: Prosper homes are still going up, and the easiest time to plan motorized custom drapery is while the walls are open and the window plan is still on paper.
prosper-tx.p1: Motorized drapery tracks need power, and in a new Prosper build that conversation belongs before the drywall goes up. We walk the house with you, mark which windows get drapery and which get shades, and help you decide which ones to wire. A great room with two rows of glass can be planned so its drapery and shades run from one control.
prosper-tx.p2: Rooms you decide not to wire can take drapery on a manual rod and still look tailored with generous fullness and a precise hem. Panel measurements come after the walls and trim are finished, taken on site by the team that installs.
faqs: Should I plan motorized drapery before drywall in my Prosper build?
Yes, if you want it wired. Deciding early lets us plan power at the windows where a motorized track will run. Final measurements are taken once the walls are finished.
Can drapery and shades in my Prosper home run from one control?
Motorized drapery tracks and motorized shades can be planned to run together from a remote, app, voice assistant or schedule. We map the groups with you at the consultation.

coppell-tx.lead: In an open Coppell floor plan the kitchen, dining and living windows sit in one view, and custom drapery should tie them together while each window does its own job.
coppell-tx.p1: When three rooms share one sightline, the drapery decision in a Coppell home is made once for all of them: one fabric, one rod finish and one mounting height across the main floor. The kitchen window may skip drapery entirely while the living room and dining room carry it. We measure every opening on site so the heights line up.
coppell-tx.p2: The slider in the middle of the room is usually the widest piece of glass. Drapery on a track draws across it and stacks beside the door, and the same fabric continues the look. At the dining table, a shade under the drapery cuts the glare.
faqs: Should all the drapery on my Coppell main floor match?
In an open plan, matching fabric and rod height across the sightline looks the most planned. Individual windows can still differ underneath, with the shade chosen for each room.
Can drapery cover the slider in the middle of my Coppell living area?
Yes, on a rod or track wide enough for the panels to stack beside the door. Using the same fabric as the nearby windows keeps the room consistent.

hurst-tx.lead: Hurst homes wear out the treatments beside water first, so custom drapery goes where it lasts longest: the living room, dining room and bedrooms away from steam and splashes.
hurst-tx.p1: Once the windows beside the tub, sink and laundry have shutters or faux wood, the dry rooms of a Hurst home are where drapery makes the biggest difference. A living room with panels hung high and wide looks taller and more finished, and well-anchored rods keep the panels straight through years of daily use.
hurst-tx.p2: In a primary suite that opens into the bath, stop the drapery at the bedroom windows and keep the bath on a treatment that handles steam. A blackout panel with a sheer is a common bedroom pairing, and we quote it with installation included.
faqs: Can drapery go in a Hurst bathroom?
We generally keep drapery out of rooms with steam. Shutters or faux wood blinds suit the tub and sink windows, and drapery goes in the bedroom next door.
Which rooms in my Hurst home are best for drapery?
The living room, dining room and bedrooms, where fabric stays dry. Those are also the rooms where added height and softness show the most.

weatherford-tx.lead: Weatherford ranch and farmhouse homes with wood ceilings and views over open land suit custom drapery in fabrics that sit well beside wood and stone.
weatherford-tx.p1: On a Weatherford window that looks over open land, drapery should frame the view and get out of its way. We extend the rod past the frame so the panels stack on the wall, and choose a hem that kisses the floor for a tailored look or floats for a relaxed one. Heavier fabrics suit rooms with wood ceilings.
weatherford-tx.p2: Small windows set in stone or plank walls can look larger with the rod mounted higher and wider than the opening. In bedrooms, drapery over a woven wood shade layers texture with function. The door to the patio can take panels on a track.
faqs: Can drapery make the small windows in my Weatherford home look bigger?
Mounting the rod higher and extending it past the frame makes a small window read larger. We measure the wall around each one to find the right height and width.
What drapery fabric suits a Weatherford home with wood ceilings?
Fabrics with some weight and texture hold their own against wood and stone. We bring samples to the free consultation and hold them up in your own light.

southlake-tx.lead: Southlake living rooms and primary suites often have the windows left for last, and custom drapery over a working shade is what completes them.
southlake-tx.p1: Southlake rooms are often furnished and styled before the windows are done. Drapery hung high and wide, with generous fullness, brings the window up to the level of the rest of the room. Underneath, a cellular shade or shutter handles light and privacy, which leaves the drapery free to be chosen for fabric and finish.
southlake-tx.p2: In the primary suite, full-width drapery across the whole wall turns several windows into one soft backdrop for the bed. Across a sliding door, sheers on a track soften the glass and stack beside it when the door is in use. A motorized track handles a long run with one command.
faqs: Can drapery span the full wall in my Southlake primary suite?
Yes, a ceiling track or long rod anchored for the span can carry full-width panels across several windows, and a motorized track opens the whole wall at once.
Do sheers work across a sliding door in Southlake?
Yes, sheer panels on a track draw across the door and stack beside it when open, so the door slides freely and the room keeps its light.

colleyville-tx.lead: Colleyville homes that start with the shutter finish, painted to the trim or stained to the floors, can add custom drapery that ties the window to the rest of the room.
colleyville-tx.p1: Once the shutters are chosen in a Colleyville study or den, drapery is the next layer. Side panels on a rod mounted above the shutter frame keep the louvers free to tilt and add the softness a room full of wood and trim often lacks. Choose fabric against the shutter finish, with richer colors beside stained wood and lighter ones beside paint.
colleyville-tx.p2: In living and dining rooms with painted shutters, drapery adds color and height alongside the trim. We bring fabric samples to your home so you see them beside the shutter samples in your own light.
faqs: Can drapery hang over stained shutters in my Colleyville den?
Yes, we mount the rod above and outside the shutter frame so the panels frame the shutters and the louvers still tilt. Fabric is chosen against the stain.
Should drapery match the trim in a Colleyville living room?
Painted shutters already match the trim, so drapery is a chance to add color or texture. We help you choose with samples in the room.

corsicana-tx.lead: Every Corsicana window starts with a mount decision, and custom drapery adds a third option: hardware above and beyond the frame that covers it completely when drawn.
corsicana-tx.p1: A shade or blind sits inside the frame or covers it. Drapery is mounted on the wall or ceiling, so the frame depth does not limit it. In Corsicana homes with good trim, we often pair an inside-mount shade that shows off the trim with drapery panels that stack on the wall beside it and close over the whole window at night.
corsicana-tx.p2: Where the trim is plain or the window is small, mounting drapery above and wide of the frame makes the opening look larger. We check each Corsicana opening on site and recommend the mount and hardware it supports.
faqs: Does drapery work on shallow window frames in Corsicana?
Yes, drapery mounts to the wall or ceiling above the window, so the depth of the frame does not matter. A shade inside the frame still needs enough depth.
Can drapery go over an inside-mount shade in my Corsicana home?
Yes, the shade sits inside the frame and shows off the trim, and the drapery hangs outside it. We plan the rod so both work on their own.

gainesville-tx.lead: Gainesville homes are often older, and their older windows let the weather in, so custom drapery here is planned as the outer layer over a shade that insulates.
gainesville-tx.p1: Single-pane glass in an older Gainesville house gets a double cell shade first, since its cells slow heat in both directions. Drapery comes next in the rooms where you feel the weather most, hung outside the frame and closed in the evening. Older walls and trim may not be level, and our installers set each rod true anyway.
gainesville-tx.p2: Start with the coldest room and add others as the budget allows. We measure every window at the first visit, write one quote with installation included, and remake anything that does not match the approved measurements at no cost.
faqs: Can drapery hang level in an older Gainesville house?
Yes, our installers level every rod or track at installation, whatever the trim and walls are doing, and anchor the hardware for your wall.
What should go under drapery on single-pane windows in Gainesville?
A double cell shade, which insulates the glass in summer and winter. The drapery hangs in front as the finished layer, and both are on one written quote.

taylor-tx.lead: Taylor living rooms that face the street need daylight in the day and a closed-off room at night, and custom drapery is the layer you draw at dusk.
taylor-tx.p1: During the day a banded shade in a Taylor front room lets light in and blocks the view from the street. At night, drapery closes over the whole window, shade and all, giving the room a warm, finished look from inside. We mount the rod outside and above the frame so the panels clear the shade, and quote both together.
taylor-tx.p2: A bedroom that doubles as an office can pair a dual shade with a blackout drapery panel for sleeping. Leave bathrooms and kitchens to faux wood, which handles the steam. We plan each room in one visit.
faqs: Can drapery give my Taylor front room privacy at night?
Yes, drawn at dusk, drapery covers the whole window and the shade behind it. During the day, the banded shade handles privacy while letting light through.
What drapery suits a Taylor bedroom that is also an office?
A blackout panel over a dual shade. The shade switches between light and privacy during work hours, and the drapery darkens the room for sleep.

trophy-club-tx.lead: Trophy Club homes that back onto a golf course, park or green space need privacy that adjusts, and custom drapery frames those back windows over a shade or shutter that does.
trophy-club-tx.p1: People walking past the back of a Trophy Club home can see straight in, and the view out is still worth keeping. A top-down shade or tilted shutter louvers handle that, and drapery hung outside the frame adds the softness and height the room needs. With the rod extended wide, open panels stack off the glass and the green stays in view.
trophy-club-tx.p2: Breakfast bays facing the yard are the harder windows. Drapery may frame the bay from the wall on each side, with shades on the glass inside it. We work out the layout on site with the bay in front of us.
faqs: How do drapery and shutters work together on my Trophy Club back windows?
The shutter louvers tilt for privacy from people passing by, and drapery panels frame the window from outside the shutter frame. The panels stack beside it when open.
Can you hang drapery around a breakfast bay in Trophy Club?
Often, yes. The layout depends on the walls beside the bay, so we measure on site and recommend where rods or tracks can go and where shades fit better.

granbury-tx.lead: Granbury homes with large windows, some facing the lake, lose color to the afternoon sun, and custom drapery can be drawn for those hours over a solar shade.
granbury-tx.p1: The solar shade cuts glare and UV at the glass, which slows fading in a Granbury living room. Drapery adds a layer you close during the worst hours, and a motorized track can do that on a schedule while nobody is home. Plan each room around what is inside it: rugs, wood floors, upholstery and art.
granbury-tx.p2: Upper windows and gables are usually out of reach, so they suit motorized shades more than drapery. On the large windows below them, a ceiling track carries tall panels, anchored for the wall and sized to stack beside the glass.
faqs: Can motorized drapery close itself in my Granbury home during the afternoon?
Yes, a motorized drapery track can follow a schedule, closing during the hours the sun hits and opening again later, without anyone at home.
Should the gable windows in my Granbury home get drapery?
Usually not. Gable and upper windows are hard to reach, so motorized shades suit them better. Drapery fits the large windows you can reach below.

roanoke-tx.lead: Newer Roanoke houses tend to have plain rectangular windows with builder blinds, and custom drapery adds the fabric, color and softness those rooms are missing.
roanoke-tx.p1: A plain window in a Roanoke dining room changes the moment drapery goes up near the ceiling and wide of the frame. The panels add height and pattern, and the builder blind behind them keeps doing its job until you replace it. We quote fabric panels and hardware together with installation, so lengths and stack widths are planned.
roanoke-tx.p2: In open living areas, use one fabric across the windows you see together. Where a softer shade suits the window, a roman shade under the drapery gives you two fabrics that can match or contrast. Bring your ideas to the free consultation.
faqs: Is drapery or a roman shade better for a plain Roanoke window?
Many rooms use both. The roman shade adds fabric at the glass and controls light, and drapery frames the window and adds height.
What drapery fabrics work in an open Roanoke living area?
Pick one fabric for every window you see at once, then vary the shade underneath by room. Pattern works well on plain windows, and we bring samples to compare in your own light.

northlake-tx.lead: Northlake's newer neighborhoods have young trees and little shade yet, and custom drapery over a solar shade gives sun-struck rooms a finished look while the yard grows in.
northlake-tx.p1: With nothing shading the house, most Northlake glass takes direct sun part of the day. A solar shade cuts that heat and glare, and drapery in front adds the finish a bare shade leaves out. Hung high and wide, the panels make standard windows look larger and stack off the glass when open.
northlake-tx.p2: Bedrooms on the sunny side suit a blackout panel layered with a sheer. The back door can take drapery on a rod or track that stacks beside it. We measure every opening on site and quote shade and drapery together.
faqs: Is drapery enough for sunny windows in a new Northlake home?
On direct-sun glass, pair it with a solar shade, which cuts heat and glare. Drapery then adds softness and the finished look over it.
Can you hang drapery at the back door of my Northlake house?
Yes, if the rod extends far enough that the panels stack fully beside the door. We measure the swing or slide and the walkway at the consultation.

highland-park-tx.lead: In Highland Park homes the windows are designed with the fabrics, furniture and trim, and custom drapery has to be built and hung to that same standard.
highland-park-tx.p1: Rod height, bracket spacing and panel length decide whether drapery looks custom in a Highland Park room. We mount close to the ceiling to add height, extend wide so the panels stack off the glass, and hem to kiss the floor or float above it exactly. Every rod goes in level and anchored, including heavy rods and ceiling tracks.
highland-park-tx.p2: Layering finishes the window: a tailored roman shade for light control, drapery with real fullness at the sides, and a sheer where the room wants softness. We bring fabric samples to the consultation and plan each layer with you.
faqs: Can drapery and roman shades be planned together for my Highland Park home?
Yes, we measure both on site, set the rod above and outside the shade, and quote fabric panels, shades, hardware and installation together.
How do you make sure drapery hangs level in a Highland Park home?
Our installers level every rod and track at installation and anchor it for the wall. If anything does not match the approved measurements, it is remade at no cost.

richland-hills-tx.lead: Established Richland Hills homes often have wood trim, cabinets, floors and a mantel, and custom drapery chosen against that wood finishes the rooms it hangs in.
richland-hills-tx.p1: When real wood blinds are stained to the trim in a Richland Hills living room, drapery is what keeps the window from reading as all wood. A fabric in a color pulled from the floors or the mantel ties it together. Panels on a rod above the blind frame stack beside the window and leave the slats free to tilt.
richland-hills-tx.p2: Choose the rod finish with the wood in mind too, since it sits right above the trim. Kitchens and baths can stay with faux wood, and the drapery goes in the living room, dining room and bedrooms.
faqs: What drapery color suits a Richland Hills room with a lot of wood?
Often a color pulled from the floors, mantel or upholstery, so the window ties into the room. We bring fabric samples and hold them up against your wood.
Can drapery hang over real wood blinds in my Richland Hills home?
Yes, the rod mounts above and outside the blind so the slats tilt freely, and the panels stack on the wall beside the window when open.

gun-barrel-city-tx.lead: A Gun Barrel City house on Cedar Creek Lake is built to look at the water, and custom drapery frames that view while a solar shade behind it filters the UV.
gun-barrel-city-tx.p1: The glass facing the lake lets in the sun that fades floors, rugs and furniture. In a Gun Barrel City living room, a solar shade filters UV while keeping the water in sight, and drapery adds the finishing layer. Hung wide, the panels stack on the wall and leave the whole view open.
gun-barrel-city-tx.p2: If the house sits empty some days, a motorized drapery track can close the panels on a schedule during the brightest hours and open them again in the evening. Shade for the deck and porch is planned separately, at the same consultation.
faqs: Can drapery close on a schedule at my Gun Barrel City lake house when I am away?
Yes, a motorized track follows the schedule you set, so the panels close in the brightest part of the day and reopen in the evening with nobody there.
What fabric works for drapery in a Gun Barrel City lake house?
Something chosen with the sun in mind, layered over a solar shade that filters UV. We bring samples to judge in the light off the water.

kerens-tx.lead: Wood trim, wood floors and wood furniture fill traditional Kerens houses, and custom drapery chosen against that wood helps the windows look like they belong there.
kerens-tx.p1: A plain white blind can look out of place in a Kerens room built around wood. Drapery softens that, framing a real wood blind or a roman shade with fabric chosen for its color and pattern next to the trim. Panels with generous fullness, hung level and high, give a traditional room the finish it was built for.
kerens-tx.p2: Paneled and wood-trimmed rooms take texture well, so a woven wood shade with drapery at the sides is another option. We bring samples to your home and quote fabric, hardware and installation together in one written quote.
faqs: Does drapery work in a Kerens room with wood paneling?
Yes, textured fabric beside paneling, often over a woven wood shade, suits those rooms. We anchor the rod for the wall it goes into.
How full should drapery be in a traditional Kerens living room?
Generously full. Panels with plenty of fabric read as finished in a traditional room, open or closed. We work out fullness and stack width from measurements taken on site.

w-7th-avenue-corsicana-tx.lead: Corsicana living rooms often have a window beside or across from the TV, and custom drapery over a light filtering shade finishes that wall while the shade takes the glare.
w-7th-avenue-corsicana-tx.p1: Our Corsicana team on W 7th Ave starts with the TV wall. A light filtering roller shade cuts glare on the screen and keeps the room bright, and drapery hung outside the frame softens a wall that is often all screen and furniture. Drawn closed for a movie at night, the drapery covers the whole window.
w-7th-avenue-corsicana-tx.p2: Light that changes by the hour suits a banded shade under the drapery. If shutters are on the TV wall, side panels frame them and leave the louvers free to tilt light away from the screen. We measure each window and quote both layers together.
faqs: Can drapery help with TV glare in my Corsicana living room?
Pair it with a light filtering shade, which cuts the glare and keeps daylight. Drapery adds softness and can be drawn closed for movies at night.
What goes under drapery on a Corsicana window with changing light?
A banded shade, which shifts between light and privacy through the day. The drapery hangs in front of it as the finished layer and closes over it at night.

las-colinas-tx.lead: Las Colinas condos, townhomes and apartments come with association rules, balcony doors and bedrooms that face lit streets, and custom drapery can be planned around all three.
las-colinas-tx.p1: From outside the building, the shade at the glass is usually what an association sees, so in a Las Colinas condo we often keep that layer consistent and put the personality into the drapery inside. A ceiling track works well where the walls leave little room for a rod. The team that measures your unit is the team that installs it.
las-colinas-tx.p2: A balcony door takes drapery on a track that stacks beside it, so the door slides freely. Bedrooms facing lit streets at night suit a blackout panel layered with a sheer over a shade. We bring samples to your unit.
faqs: Can I have drapery in my Las Colinas condo with association rules?
Drapery hangs inside the unit, and the shade at the glass can be chosen to give the consistent outside look an association asks for. Check your rules, and we will plan around them.
What drapery works on a Las Colinas balcony door?
Panels on a track that draw across the door and stack to one side, so it slides freely. A motorized track can open and close them from a remote or app.

argyle-tx.lead: Larger Argyle homes often put the study at the front, facing the street, and custom drapery around its shutters or shades gives a hard-working office a finished, private look.
argyle-tx.p1: An Argyle study at the front of the house gets used all day now. Shutters or a roman shade handle the glare on the screen and keep the street out of view, and drapery panels at the sides soften a room full of desks, shelving and hard surfaces. We set the rod above the shutter frame so the louvers still tilt.
argyle-tx.p2: The window behind you on video calls is the one people see. A sheer panel, or drapery drawn partly across it, gives the camera a softer background. We measure the room, bring fabric samples and quote everything with installation included.
faqs: Can drapery go in an Argyle home office with shutters?
Yes, side panels on a rod above the shutter frame frame the window and leave the louvers free. The shutters do the light work, and the drapery finishes the room.
What helps the window behind me on calls in my Argyle study?
A shade to control the light plus drapery for a softer background. A sheer panel keeps the room bright and gives the camera something better to see than bare glass.

justin-tx.lead: Justin homes with open floor plans show the kitchen, dining and living windows at once, and custom drapery in one color family keeps that main floor looking planned.
justin-tx.p1: Pick a color family for the main floor of a Justin home and let the drapery carry it from the dining room to the living room. The fabrics can differ in weight or texture and still read as one plan. The kitchen window usually gets a shade or blind in the same family, since it sits close to the sink.
justin-tx.p2: Bedrooms down the hall can go their own way. A blackout panel with a sheer suits a primary bedroom, and a child's room can take a bolder fabric. We plan every room at the free in-home consultation and write one quote.
faqs: Can bedroom drapery in my Justin home differ from the main floor?
Yes, the main floor reads as one view, so it shares a color family, while bedrooms are seen one at a time and can use any fabric that suits the room.
What goes on the kitchen window in a Justin open floor plan?
Usually a shade or blind in the same color family as the drapery nearby. It keeps the sightline consistent and stays practical beside the sink.

boyd-tx.lead: Boyd homes out in the country take wind and weather on every side, and custom drapery in those rooms works as the outer layer over a shade that insulates the glass.
boyd-tx.p1: Older windows in Boyd let in the January cold and the July heat. The insulating work goes to a double cell shade, or to shutters closed at night. Drapery hangs in front as the finishing layer, and a heavier fabric drawn in the evening covers the whole window, frame included.
boyd-tx.p2: In bedrooms, a roman shade with an insulating liner can sit under the drapery for a softer look. Rods on older walls go in level and anchored for the wall, and every opening is measured on site by the team that installs.
faqs: Should my Boyd windows get drapery or double cell shades first?
Start with the double cell shades on the windows that take the weather, since they insulate the glass. Add drapery after in the rooms where you want the finished look.
Can drapery go over a roman shade with an insulating liner in Boyd?
Yes, we mount the drapery rod above and outside the roman shade so both layers work independently, and quote both together with installation.

westlake-tx.lead: Opening and closing every drapery panel by hand in a large Westlake home is a chore nobody keeps up with, and motorized custom drapery tracks take it over.
westlake-tx.p1: Westlake homes with many windows suit motorized drapery tracks grouped the same way as the shades: by room, by side of the house and by time of day. One command glides a whole wall of panels open, and a schedule can close the west side every afternoon. Tracks run quietly and smoothly, and long spans are anchored for the wall.
westlake-tx.p2: Under the drapery, motorized woven or cellular shades handle the light at the glass, and both layers can follow the same routine. We plan the groups and the fabrics in one visit and quote shades, drapery, tracks and installation together.
faqs: Can motorized drapery in my Westlake home be grouped by room?
Yes, tracks can be grouped by room, by side of the house or by time of day, and run from a remote, app, voice assistant or schedule.
How quiet are motorized drapery tracks in a Westlake bedroom?
Quieter and smoother than most people expect. We install them with the right anchors for the span, and the same team that measures handles the installation.

paradise-tx.lead: Corner rooms in Paradise homes take sun on one wall in the morning and the other in the afternoon, and custom drapery can be planned so both walls meet cleanly.
paradise-tx.p1: In a Paradise corner room each wall gets its own shade: a top-down shade on the morning side, a tighter weave on the afternoon side. Drapery ties the two together. Panels on each wall can stack toward the corner or away from it, and we decide that on site so the corner looks deliberate when the drapery is open.
paradise-tx.p2: Corner bedrooms suit a blackout drapery panel on both walls, drawn at night to cover both windows. Matching rod height and fabric on both walls keeps the room balanced. Every opening is measured in person, and the quote includes installation.
faqs: How do you hang drapery in a Paradise corner bedroom?
On a rod or track for each wall, set at the same height with matching fabric. We plan where the panels stack so the corner looks clean open or closed.
Can each wall of a Paradise corner room have different shades under the drapery?
Yes, the morning wall might take a top-down shade and the afternoon wall a tighter weave. The drapery is the same on both, so the room still looks like one plan.
